color.summary: Dark everywhere a user looks: the web player and the login page are #121212 pages in a #000 frame, with white ink and #b3b3b3 for secondary text. Containers step up in grey: #1f1f1f for the search field and the sidebar's prompt cards, #282828 for menus, tooltips and dialogs, #2a2a2a on hover. The bright accent #1ed760 carries black labels. Control edges are #7c7c7c.
usage: Encore's light theme ships with the design system but no page uses it: a white page in a #f5f5f5 frame, ink #000, muted #656565, edges #818181, and the darker #159542 for checks, radios and tab bars.
The Settings switch is on in #1db954, the older brand green.

type.summary: Spotify Mix, proprietary, in two cuts: SpotifyMixUI for text and SpotifyMixUITitle for titles. Text is 16px and 14px at 400; buttons, labels and tags are 700. Shelf titles are 24px at 700 and the login title 48px at 800.

shape.summary: Buttons, filter chips and the search field are pills. Fields, menus, tags and banners have 4px corners, the language dialog 8px, home cards 6px, Library rows 6px and context menu rows 2px.

spacing.summary: Buttons are 32, 48 and 56px with 16 or 32px sides; fields 48px. Context menu rows are 40px with 12px padding, filter chips 32px with 12px padding, line tabs 48px. Library rows are 64px around a 48px cover.

elevation.summary: Flat greys do the layering; shadows are only for floating parts. Context menus take 0 16px 24px at 30% plus 0 6px 8px at 20%, and cover images sit on 0 8px 24px at 50%. The language dialog has no shadow, over a 70% black scrim. Focus is a 2px outline 2px outside, in the body ink. Disabled controls are at 30% opacity.

button.summary: Encore's buttons are 700-weight pills: primary in the bright green, secondary on a grey fill, tertiary with no fill, and a bordered secondary. The login page and the web player ship Encore's older legacy button (48px with 32px sides). Most of the player's own buttons are icon circles in #b3b3b3.
